github._comment: GitHub API configuration for star history fetching

cache._comment: Cache settings to avoid redundant API calls

ttl._comment_ttl: Time-to-live in seconds for different cache categories

thresholds._comment: Quality and matching thresholds for skill filtering and analysis

quality._min_stars_help: Minimum GitHub stars to consider a skill
quality._max_months_help: Maximum age in months since last update

similarity._threshold_help: Minimum cosine similarity (0.0-1.0) for skill matching

replacement._confidence_help: Minimum confidence score (0.0-1.0) for replacement recommendations

weights._comment_weights: Multi-factor confidence score weights (must sum to 1.0)

security._threshold_help: Minimum security score (0-100) to pass evaluation

weights._comment_weights: Security score component weights (must sum to 1.0)

sections._comment_sections: Which sections to include in comprehensive report

top_n._comment_top_n: Number of results to include in each report section

parallel_processing._max_workers_help: Number of parallel workers (0 = auto-detect CPU count)

performance._batch_size_help: Process skills in batches of this size to manage memory
performance._memory_limit_help: Maximum memory usage before triggering batch processing

discover_new_skills._exclude_installed_help: Filter out already installed skills from discovery

calculate_growth_rates._time_window_help: Calculate growth over this many days (7 = week-over-week)

find_similar_skills._include_installed_help: If true, only find alternatives for installed skills

evaluate_replacements._require_better_stars_help: Only recommend replacements with equal or more stars

security_evaluation._fail_on_critical_help: Abort analysis if critical security issues found

logging._level_help: Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL

skill_manager._verify_help: Check database exists and is valid before analysis
skill_manager._min_expected_help: Alert if database has fewer skills than this
